title: The Protocol of the Deep
author: Rafael Ravensworth
blurb: Jonah Winterbourne, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
